purpose: Track conversion of source-backed wiki entries into visible Hypertext d20-compatible statistics. Lore-only entries remain incomplete for rules-facing wiki use until their relevant statistics are converted or explicitly marked as non-mechanical.
rules: Creature entries that describe combat-capable beings should receive statBlocks.
Hazard entries should receive hazard or encounter stat blocks instead of only prose warnings.
Vehicle and airship entries should receive vessel statistics, crew requirements, cargo, speed, armor, hull, control, and weapon data where source material supports it.
Equipment entries should receive converted item statistics or clearly marked conversion notes.
Legacy mechanics should not remain as final output; they must be converted into Hypertext d20-compatible statistics or marked needs-review.
Converted statistics must be loaded after lore packs in wiki-index.json so they replace placeholder mechanics sections.

completedPasses.scope: Beasts of the Abyss creature entry: Abyssal Maw, Shadowwing Leviathan, Sable Tendrils, Blackclaw, Nightmare Hound, and Gloomrider.
